recommended_conservation: Pack-in-pack-out enforcement; edelweiss protection awareness; summit trail erosion control; Ranu Kumbolo water quality monitoring
unique_selling_point: Highest peak in Java; iconic Ranu Kumbolo alpine lake; Oro-oro Ombo savanna; volcanic sunrise from summit
minimum_gear: 4-season tent; -5°C sleeping bag; trekking poles; gaiters; headlamp; windproof jacket; balaclava; gloves

common_accident_types: Altitude sickness; falls on summit scree; hypothermia; dehydration

common_accident_types: Hypothermia; lost trail in fog; slips on wet terrain

common_accident_types: Falls from crater rim; lost trail in forest; dehydration; hypothermia

camping_area: Cisentor (flat); savanna plateau near summit; multiple informal sites
common_issues: Trail markers overgrown; illegal logging at lower elevations
recommended_conservation: Trail marking and maintenance; anti-logging initiative; wildlife monitoring; water source protection
unique_selling_point: Longest hiking trail in Java; true multi-day wilderness expedition; Rengganis hot crater; pristine ecosystem
minimum_gear: 4-season tent; -5°C sleeping bag; 3-4 days food supply; water purification; GPS device; trekking poles; machete (overgrown trail sections)
common_accident_types: Lost trail/disorientation; dehydration; animal encounters; exhaustion

emergency_contact: TN-BTS Cemoro Lawang post; BASARNAS Probolinggo

name: Ijen (Kawah Ijen)
basecamp_access: From Banyuwangi via Licin (1.5h); or from Bondowoso via Sempol (2h); paved road to Paltuding

common_issues: Sulfur miner exploitation/safety; tourist trash at crater rim; acid lake contamination risk
recommended_conservation: Sulfur miner welfare programs; gas mask distribution; crater area waste cleanup; visitor education on toxic gas risks
unique_selling_point: Blue fire phenomenon (one of two locations worldwide); turquoise acid crater lake; sulfur miners; dramatic pre-dawn hike
minimum_gear: Gas mask (activated carbon); headlamp; warm jacket; good grip shoes; gloves
common_accident_types: Gas inhalation (most common); slips in crater; cold exposure
